# Contested_Priors_Mechanism

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A neuromorphic process where multiple competing prior hypotheses are simultaneously evaluated and resolved within an in-network computing substrate. Supports real-time Bayesian inference and adaptive learning directly within the network, reducing latency and energy overhead in iNEST systems.
